fusions.name: Final Syllable
fusions.desc: After a 1.2 second cast, sends a sting that deals 28 damage and bursts for 80% of that on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, leaving them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Recited Dose
fusions.desc: Stings the target 2 times, a strike that deals 8 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Quickened Tongue
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 25% for 12 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Line
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next ability deals 20% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
